description: This file defines the 'CborFactory' interface, which abstracts serialization and deserialization of JSON values via CBOR encoding. It includes methods for checking CBOR availability, reading CBOR data from byte arrays and ByteBuffers, and writing JSON values into CBOR format, either as byte arrays or ByteBuffers. The interface supports creating CBOR representations from JSON fields and lists, with size estimation.

methods.name: isCborAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the necessary libraries for CBOR serialization are available.

methods.name: readFrom
methods.description: Deserializes CBOR bytes into a JsonValue from a byte array starting at a specific offset and length.

methods.name: readFrom
methods.description: Deserializes CBOR bytes into a JsonValue from a ByteBuffer.

methods.name: toByteArray
methods.description: Serializes a JsonValue into a CBOR byte array.

methods.name: toByteBuffer
methods.description: Serializes a JsonValue into a CBOR ByteBuffer.

methods.name: writeToByteBuffer
methods.description: Serializes a JsonValue into an existing ByteBuffer.

methods.name: createCborRepresentation
methods.description: Creates a CBOR byte array from a map of JsonFields with an estimated size.

methods.name: createCborRepresentation
methods.description: Creates a CBOR byte array from a list of JsonValues with an estimated size.
